ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited (AHCL) has announced a significant development in its corporate restructuring, with the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) sanctioning the amalgamation of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited (AEHL) into AHCL. This move consolidates the two entities, with the scheme retroactively effective from April 1, 2026 (Appointed Date), impacting their combined financial reporting and operations. The company will provide further updates regarding the Effective Date and share exchange ratio, and no immediate red flags are apparent, as this represents procedural progress on a planned merger.
